title: From Attachment to steadier practice
subtitle: A deliberate path through attachment
description: Guru teaches love without possession and steadiness without denial. This path starts with short guidance, opens the topic fully, and then stays long enough with Gurbani to change pace.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Steadiness is seen in not being bound by praise, blame, pleasure, or pain.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let feedback inform you without governing your worth.
